db_instance_id.description: (Required) The ID of the existing PolarDB instance. This module does NOT create instances - only manages backup policy for existing ones.

i18n.zh-Hans: （必填）现有PolarDB实例的ID。本模块不会创建实例，仅用于管理现有实例的备份策略。
i18n.en-US: (Required) The ID of the existing PolarDB instance. This module does NOT create instances—only manages backup policies for existing ones.

backup_retention_period.description: The retention period of data backup files. Valid values: 7 to 730.

i18n.zh-Hans: 数据备份文件的保留期限，有效值为7至730天。
i18n.en-US: The retention period for data backup files. Valid values: 7 to 730.

preferred_backup_period.description: The backup cycle. Separate multiple values with commas. Valid values: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

i18n.zh-Hans: 备份周期。多个值用逗号分隔。有效值：周一、周二、周三、周四、周五、周六、周日。
i18n.en-US: The backup cycle. Separate multiple values with commas. Valid values: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

preferred_backup_time.description: The backup time in format HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ (UTC time).

i18n.zh-Hans: 备份时间，格式为 HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ（UTC 时间）。
i18n.en-US: The backup time in HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ format (UTC time).

enable_backup_log.description: Whether to enable log backup. Valid values: 1 (enabled), 0 (disabled).

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否启用日志备份。取值：1（启用）、0（禁用）。
i18n.en-US: Whether to enable log backup. Valid values: 1 (enabled), 0 (disabled).

compress_type.description: The backup compression method. Valid values: 0 (no compression), 1 (zlib), 2 (parallel zlib), 4 (quicklz), 8 (MySQL 8.0 quicklz).

i18n.zh-Hans: 备份压缩方法。有效值：0（不压缩）、1（zlib）、2（并行 zlib）、4（QuickLZ）、8（MySQL 8.0 QuickLZ）。
i18n.en-US: The backup compression method. Valid values: 0 (no compression), 1 (zlib), 2 (parallel zlib), 4 (QuickLZ), 8 (MySQL 8.0 QuickLZ).

backup_policy_mode.description: The backup policy mode. Valid values: DataBackupPolicy, LogBackupPolicy.

i18n.zh-Hans: 备份策略模式。有效值：DataBackupPolicy（数据备份策略）、LogBackupPolicy（日志备份策略）。
i18n.en-US: The backup policy mode. Valid values: DataBackupPolicy, LogBackupPolicy.

backup_log.description: Log backup switch. Value: Enable | Disabled.

i18n.zh-Hans: 日志备份开关。值：启用 | 禁用。
i18n.en-US: Log backup switch. Value: Enable | Disable.

high_space_usage_protection.description: Whether to force Binlog cleanup when space usage is high. Valid values: Disable, Enable.

i18n.zh-Hans: 当磁盘空间使用率较高时，是否强制清理二进制日志。有效值：禁用、启用。
i18n.en-US: Whether to force binlog cleanup when disk space usage is high. Valid values: Disable, Enable.

i18n.zh-Hans: 日志备份本地保留小时数。

local_log_retention_space.description: The maximum circular space usage of local logs. Value: 0~50.

i18n.zh-Hans: 本地日志的最大循环空间使用量。取值范围：0~50。
i18n.en-US: The maximum circular space usage for local logs. Value: 0–50.

log_backup_retention_period.description: The retention period of log backup files. Valid values: 7 to 730.

i18n.zh-Hans: 日志备份文件的保留期限，有效值为7至730。
i18n.en-US: The retention period for log backup files. Valid values: 7 to 730.
